American Express Platinum Card credits and when they expire

Every statement credit on the American Express Platinum Card (annual fee $895), what it is worth, and when it resets. Last verified October 2, 2026.

CreditAmountResets
Airline fee credit$200 per yearEvery calendar year (Dec 31)
Uber Cash
$15 a month, plus a bonus in December that brings the year to $200. The app counts $15 each month, so December's extra $20 is not in your totals. Amex also lists extra Uber Cash in December. PerkaBoo tracks the $15 monthly amount.		$15 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Digital entertainment credit
Enrollment required.		$25 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Walmart+ credit
Applied automatically while you are a member.		$12.95 per monthEvery month (last day of the month)
Resy credit
Enrollment required.		$100 per quarterEvery quarter: Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31
lululemon credit
Enrollment required.		$75 per quarterEvery quarter: Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31
Hotel credit (Amex Travel)$300 every six monthsTwice a year: Jun 30 and Dec 31
CLEAR+ credit$219 per yearEvery calendar year (Dec 31)

If you used every recurring credit above in a full year, that adds up to about $2,354.40 against the $895 annual fee. Most people use only some of them, which is why tracking matters.

Details come from the issuer's public terms and reputable reviews, and issuers change credits often. Always confirm the current terms with your issuer before relying on a credit. PerkaBoo is not affiliated with any card issuer or bank.
